title: Exploring quarterback options for Giants to add following Jaxson Dart's season-ending injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Exploring quarterback options for Giants to add following Jaxson Dart's season-ending injury
sources.description: The Giants will rally around Jameis Winston as their new starting quarterback following Jaxson Dart's season-ending injury. However, New York will certainly add to its quarterbacks room at some point in the near future. Here are some of the more likely options...
